Data Dependent Acquisition (DDA) for library construction

alkylation_concentration.evidence: alkylated with 30 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) (Sigma-Aldrich, 16125-25 G) in the dark at room temperature for 30 min

alkylation_reagent.evidence: alkylated with 30 mM iodoacetamide (IAA) (Sigma-Aldrich, 16125-25 G) in the dark at room temperature for 30 min

cleavage_agent.evidence: digested overnight at 37 °C using sequencing-grade porcine trypsin (Promega, V511A) at a 1:30 enzyme-to-substrate ratio

collision_energy.evidence: HCD collision energy of 27%; Orbitrap resolution of 35,000 at m/z 200 Da with a standard AGC target and automatic maximum injection time mode

fractionation_method.evidence: Peptide mixtures (~150 µg) were fractionated employing the high-pH reversed-phase C18 (HpH) peptide fractionation method, using a ZORBAX 300 Extend-C18 2.1 × 150 mm, 3.5 µm column on a 1260 HPLC system (Agilent, CA, USA)

fragmentation_method.evidence: Product ions were generated via higher-energy collisional dissociation (HCD) mode and mass analysed in the orbitrap using the following parameters: HCD collision energy of 27%; Orbitrap resolution of 35,000 at m/z 200 Da with a standard AGC target and automatic maximum injection time mode

ionization_type.evidence: The column eluent was directed into the ionisation source of the mass spectrometer operating in positive ion mode.

labeling.evidence: inferred: Peptide abundances were aggregated to the protein-level using the ion-based protein quantification (iq) R package, an implementation of the MaxLFQ algorithm.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Survey scans were recorded in the m/z range of 350–1450 using the orbitrap with a resolution of 60,000 at m/z 200 Da

ptm.evidence: Carbamidomethyl of cysteine was set as a fixed modification, and oxidation of methionine and acetylation of the protein N-termini were set as variable modifications

reduction_concentration.evidence: Proteins were reduced with 15 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) (Sigma-Aldrich, D0632-5G) at 60 °C for 30 min

reduction_reagent.evidence: Proteins were reduced with 15 mM dithiothreitol (DTT) (Sigma-Aldrich, D0632-5G) at 60 °C for 30 min
